Opps of the Week: Fortune, NPR, Chicago Media Journal
Write about big tech for $1.25 per word
November 24, 2026
Opps of the Week: Fortune, NPR, Chicago Media Journal
Write about big tech for $1.25 per word
ICYMI: Interview with Aatish Taseer
On the latest podcast
episode
,
Aatish Taseer
discussed his new memoir —
The Rootless Elysium: America at 250, A Journey
. In this conversation, the writer opened up about his experience being exiled from India and noted the parallels (and differences) between Indian history and the current American political climate. In addition, Taseer shared tips for delving into one’s experience and challenging the tropes of a road trip memoir.
Listen on
Apple Podcasts
or watch on
YouTube
